prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_spotlight_redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a focused spotlight layout with high-visibility hero pet previews.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"headline": "Choose Your Desktop Pet Companion", "layout": "spotlight"}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] reorder_sign_in_after_pick_friend: Move the sign-in prompt to occur right after picking a friend, letting users choose their pet before creating or logging into an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [home, new_screen] new_screen_desktop_display_check: Add a new screen during waiting to verify desktop display rendering before finalizing onboarding.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_display_check", "home_intro"], "waiting": {"headline": "Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Space"}}
3: [choose_path, new_flow] story_scroll_intro_flow: Transform the initial story presentation into a story_scroll interactive narrative layout.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Discover Your New Desktop Friend", "layout": "story_scroll"}}
4: [adoption, hint] adoption_custom_photo_quality_hint: Display explicit guidance on photo lighting and facial clarity during pet photo upload.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use clear, well-lit photos with a centered face for best pet generation results."}}
5: [sign_in, copy] sign_in_account_recovery_reassurance_copy: Update sign-in headline and body to reassure users that logging in protects and restores existing pet progress.
   config: {"sign_in": {"body": "Signing in backs up your pet memory, customization, and progress safely across devices.", "headline": "Sign In to Protect Your Pet"}}
6: [finish, hint] home_intro_desktop_interaction_hint: Add an actionable hint on the final screen explaining how to summon, move, or hide the desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Click and drag your pet anywhere on screen, or right-click for quick controls."}}
7: [home, wait_info] waiting_estimated_timer_info: Show an active progress indicator and estimated remaining render time during the desktop setup wait.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
8: [finish, redesign] home_intro_spotlight_layout: Redesign home_intro with a centered spotlight layout focused on launching the pet straight to desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Ready for Desktop Action!", "layout": "spotlight"}}
9: [adoption, layout] upload_photos_progress_step_counter: Switch photo upload layout to split view and show explicit step counter progress.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "split", "show_step_counter": true}}

Reordering sign-in within onboarding while retaining all required steps is allowed.
Adding a new verification screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning the story presentation layout within onboarding is allowed.
Adding photo upload guidance text within onboarding is allowed.
Updating sign-in copy within onboarding is allowed.
Adding desktop interaction hints to home_intro is allowed.
Adding actual wait progress and time estimate is allowed.
Redesigning the home_intro layout within onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning the photo upload layout and adding a step counter is allowed.
